title: #038. VM Host Packing & Symmetry Breaking
subtitle: Pack VMs onto identical hosts with anti-affinity conflicts and break host-permutation symmetries to minimize active hosts.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { hosts, usedHosts }.
judge.m4: Anti-affinity conflict violated: VMs {p0} and {p1} were both placed on host {p2}.
judge.m5: Reported usedHosts ({p0}) does not match number of non-empty hosts ({p1}).
judge.m6: Valid placement, but usedHosts ({p0}) exceeds optimal ({p1}).
